description: Greentox is a Korean botulinum toxin type A injectable supplied in a 100-unit lyophilised vial for aesthetic use. The specific manufacturer is not clearly identified in available distributor sources, which describe it as a high-purity type A neurotoxin produced in Korean biopharmaceutical facilities. It is positioned for facial wrinkle treatment and muscle-slimming procedures.
howItWorks: Botulinum toxin type A blocks acetylcholine release at the neuromuscular junction by cleaving the SNAP-25 protein required for synaptic vesicle fusion. This produces temporary, dose-dependent chemodenervation that relaxes the targeted muscle, softening dynamic wrinkles until nerve terminals regenerate over several months.
composition: Botulinum toxin type A; 100-unit lyophilised vial reconstituted before injection. Distributor listings describe a high-purity type A neurotoxin (some cite an X58540 production strain); a verified full excipient breakdown was not located.
usageNotes: Supplied as a lyophilised powder; reconstitute with preservative-free 0.9% sterile saline before use. Store refrigerated at 2-8C and, once reconstituted, use promptly per the product insert. For administration by trained medical professionals only; dose and injection points are physician-determined.
features: Botulinum toxin type A in a 100-unit lyophilised vial
Reconstituted with sterile saline before use
benefits: Predictable, dose-dependent muscle relaxation
Cost-competitive Korean toxin option for clinic stocking
Suitable for facial wrinkle and slimming protocols
Standard reconstitution workflow familiar to injectors

It is supplied in 100- and 200-unit lyophilised vials with a human serum albumin and sodium chloride excipient profile. It is used for aesthetic reduction of dynamic facial wrinkles.

This produces temporary, dose-dependent chemodenervation that relaxes the targeted muscle, softening dynamic wrinkles until nerve terminals regenerate over several months.
composition: Botulinum toxin type A, 100 or 200 units per vial, stabilised with human serum albumin (approx. 0.5 mg) and sodium chloride (approx. 0.9 mg); lyophilised powder reconstituted with sterile saline before use.
usageNotes: Supplied as a lyophilised powder; reconstitute with preservative-free 0.9% sterile saline. Store refrigerated at 2-8C and use reconstituted solution promptly per the product insert. For administration by trained medical professionals only; dosing is physician-determined.

Marketed by Chong Kun Dang (Huons-linked toxin supply)
Excipient profile comparable to conventional type A toxins
